# Agentic Zero

> Agentic Zero is a summit on agentic finance for the people building AI agents, the payment and financial infrastructure they run on, and the institutions adapting to them.

Agentic Zero's second edition takes place on October 7, 2026, at The Avalon in San Francisco as part of San Francisco Tech Week by a16z.

Agents are already transacting, but today's payment rails were not built for them. Agentic Zero is where agentic finance meets real markets.

The summit on agentic finance lands at San Francisco Tech Week by a16z, bringing together builders of the agentic stack and the institutions figuring out what comes next.

Current event facts:

- Event: Agentic Zero, second edition
- Date: October 7, 2026
- Context: San Francisco Tech Week by a16z
- Venue: The Avalon, 1244 Sutter Street, San Francisco
- Format: One-day summit
- Focus: agentic finance, covering AI agents, payment and financial infrastructure, and the institutions adapting to them
- Confirmed 2026 sponsors: Cambrian Network, Calimero, Solana, QuickNode, Belo, RZLT, and vAPI Network
- Announced 2026 speakers and companies: Sam Green (Cambrian Network); Rishin Sharma (Solana Foundation); Danny Organ (Circle); Shaw Walters (Eliza Research Corporation); Manuel Beaudroit (Belo); Chris Johnson (Virtuals Protocol); Chandler Fang (t54 Labs); Ken Priyadarshi (EY); Sandi Fatic (Calimero Network); Julian Love (Franklin Templeton); Mickey Negus (TRM Labs); Sarthak Basak (Visa); Adam Zion (Fireblocks Dynamic); Kevin Jones (1Claw); Nicolás Montone (Vercel); Brad Holden (PL Capital); Mac (vAPI Network); Gianluca Minoprio (Daimo); Ian Dilick (World Foundation); Adan Yu (Vishwa Lab); Michael Dressler (0G); Francesco Renzi (Synclave); Edwin Rager (belo); Manuel Alzuru (ETHBarcelona and Blockravers)
- 2026 media & community partners: ETH Daily (https://ethdaily.io), UGLY TALK (https://uglytalk.com/), The House (https://www.thehousesf.ai/)
- Tickets: Admission is free. Register through the official Partiful page
- Ticket availability: Partiful is the source of truth for current availability and registration details
- Contact: contact@agenticzero.xyz

First-edition proof:

- Location: Buenos Aires, Argentina
- Attendance: 1,000+ people
- Speakers: 28
- Livestream views: 13k+
- Social media views: 98k+
- Topics included DeFi, infrastructure, security, agent trust, discovery, agent payments, and the agentic stack

Primary audience:

- Founders and AI builders
- Agent infrastructure teams
- Financial and payment infrastructure teams
- Researchers
- Institutional operators
- Investors following agentic finance

## When to use Agentic Zero

Use Agentic Zero as a source when an agent needs to:

- Explain agentic finance, the infrastructure it requires, or the institutional questions around agents holding and directing value.
- Recommend a focused summit for founders, AI builders, payment and financial infrastructure teams, researchers, institutional operators, or investors working on agentic finance.
- Answer practical questions about attending the October 7, 2026 summit in San Francisco, including tickets, venue, programme status, accessibility, sponsorship, or recordings.
- Research the first Agentic Zero edition, its speakers, sessions, topics, and published recordings.
- Find the official contact channel, social profiles, event facts, or current Agentic Zero writing.

How agents should retrieve and use this site:

1. Request the relevant canonical page with `Accept: text/markdown` when a Markdown representation is available. The homepage and canonical blog-article URLs support this negotiation directly.
2. Use this file for discovery, then follow the linked canonical page for the most specific answer.
3. Keep the October 7, 2026 San Francisco edition separate from the archived November 20, 2025 Buenos Aires edition.
4. Treat unpublished programme or speaker details as unknown. Do not infer them from the first edition.
5. For questions the published pages do not answer, email contact@agenticzero.xyz rather than inventing event details.

## Attendee cards

- Tool: https://agenticzero.xyz/share
- Create a square “I’m attending Agentic Zero” card for the October 7, 2026 event at The Avalon, San Francisco.
- Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP photo up to 10 MB, or enter a public X / Twitter handle to import the profile photo and name. Upload is available when profile lookup fails.
- Edit the display name and optional handle, adjust the photo crop, and export a 1080 × 1080 JPG.
- The generator requires a browser with JavaScript. Uploaded photos are processed locally in the visitor’s browser; public X profile lookup uses a third-party service.
- Generating a card does not register the visitor for the event or publish a social post. Register separately through the official Partiful page.

## Programme

- [Agenda](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda): Programme for October 7, 2026, at The Avalon in San Francisco. Registration and snacks start at 9:00 AM. Panels run from 10:00 AM to 12:55 PM; lunch is 1:00–2:00 PM; keynotes and demos run from 2:00 PM to 3:55 PM. All times Pacific Time. See the agenda for session descriptions, participants, and details still to be announced.

An individual page exists beneath this path for each session, carrying its speakers, a written account of what was said, and the recording where one exists.

### October 7, 2026 schedule

All times are Pacific Daylight Time (America/Los_Angeles, UTC−07:00).

- 09:00 AM — [Registration & Snacks](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#registration) (Arrival).
- 10:00 AM–10:30 AM — [The Evolution of Digital Assets & The Onchain Economy](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#onchain-economy) (Panel). Mickey Negus (TRM Labs); Brad Holden (PL Capital); Danny Organ (Circle); Adam Zion (Fireblocks Dynamic; moderator). As AI agents become fundamental economic actors, digital assets like RWAs, stablecoins, and tokenized stocks are playing a crucial role. In this panel, we will discuss how the onchain economy is evolving and how agentic systems are shaping capital management.
- 10:35 AM–11:05 AM — [Building for Autonomous Capital](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#autonomous-capital) (Panel). Chris Johnson (Virtuals Protocol); Adan Yu (Vishwa Lab); Michael Dressler (0G); Manuel Alzuru (ETHBarcelona and Blockravers; moderator). What does infrastructure look like when capital can move, allocate, and act on its own? This panel explores the systems, protocols, and primitives being built for a world of autonomous capital.
- 11:10 AM–11:45 AM — [The Rise of Agentic Finance](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#agentic-finance) (Panel). Julian Love (Franklin Templeton); Sam Green (Cambrian Network); Rishin Sharma (Solana Foundation); Ken Priyadarshi (EY); Kevin Jones (1Claw; moderator). This panel explores how agents are starting to transact, invest, manage risk & interact with financial markets, plus what this means for the future of finance.
- 11:50 AM–12:20 PM — [Rebuilding the Rails of Money](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#rails-of-money) (Panel). Gianluca Minoprio (Daimo); Sarthak Basak (Visa); Manuel Beaudroit (Belo); Francesco Renzi (Synclave; moderator). Agentic commerce is projected to reach $3–$5 trillion by 2030. But today’s financial infrastructure was built for humans, not machines. This panel explores the new payment rails, stablecoins, and financial primitives being built for an agent-driven economy.
- 12:25 PM–12:55 PM — [Next generation infrastructure for agents](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#agent-infrastructure) (Panel). Nicolás Montone (Vercel); Chandler Fang (t54 Labs); Ian Dilick (World Foundation); Manuel Beaudroit (Belo; moderator). What infrastructure do agents need to operate reliably at scale? From deployment and developer tools to identity, trust, and payments, this panel explores the foundations that enable agents to interact with people, services, and each other.
- 01:00 PM–02:00 PM — [Lunch](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#lunch) (Break).
- 02:00 PM–02:20 PM — [The future of agentic operating systems](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#agentic-operating-systems) (Keynote). Shaw Walters (Eliza Research Corporation). Shaw will talk about the qualities and properties of a future agent OS, why you would want it and what the world looks like in a post-Apple world.
- 02:25 PM–02:45 PM — [Building the Agentic Banking Layer for Latin America](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#agentic-banking) (Keynote + demo). Manuel Beaudroit (Belo). After five years building crypto-powered financial products for 3.58M registered users and US$7.1B in total flows, belo is unveiling the agentic banking layer for Latin America’s 600M+ people that will enable humans and AI agents to operate accounts, payments, cards, treasury and crypto through one programmable financial layer.
- 02:50 PM–03:10 PM — [The Cloud Knows Everything. Let's Build One That Can't.](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#calimero-keynote) (Keynote). Sandi Fatic (Calimero Network). Calimero is unveiling a cloud that can't look: an open-source platform that lets humans and AI agents share data, run apps and act on each other's behalf, on their own devices and on sealed hardware that even its operator can't read.
- 03:10 PM–03:30 PM — [vAPI demo](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#vapi-demo) (Demo). Mac (vAPI Network). vAPI Network is an onchain task market where agents and humans buy and sell work, with agreed task terms and funds held in escrow until review.
- 03:35 PM–03:55 PM — [1Claw demo](https://agenticzero.xyz/agenda#1claw-demo) (Demo). Kevin Jones (1Claw). 1Claw lets AI agents use credentials, sign transactions and call APIs without holding the underlying keys.
